title: Lead Capture & Email Notification Automation
problem: Web-form leads that only land in an inbox or a spreadsheet get missed or followed up late, and there's no consistent record of who submitted what, when.
solution: An n8n workflow that captures every form submission, standardizes the fields, logs the lead to Google Sheets, and sends an instant email notification with the full details — so nothing sits unseen.
features: Hosted web form collecting name, email, phone, service needed, and message
Automatic cleanup into consistent field names, with a default status and timestamp on every submission
Every lead logged to Google Sheets for simple tracking
Instant email notification with the full lead details the moment a form is submitted

title: AgenticDataHub
problem: Datasets relevant to a research topic are usually scattered across many pages with no single API, so finding and collecting them means manually crawling sites and writing one-off scraping code per page.
solution: A LangGraph multi-agent pipeline that crawls a seed URL, has an LLM agent judge which links are likely datasets, then routes each one to a verified download or an LLM-written extraction script — retrying failures and reusing successful parsers via a small RAG memory — before writing a Markdown summary of everything collected.
features: Multi-agent pipeline — scraper, dataset discovery, orchestrator, downloader, parser, and summary nodes sharing one typed state
LLM agent scores each discovered link for relevance and decides download vs. parse
Self-writing parser that generates and runs extraction code, retrying against real errors
RAG memory that stores successful parsers and reuses them on similar pages
Feedback/retry loop after every stage of the pipeline
Outputs a Markdown report with schemas, sample rows, and data-quality notes

title: Medical RAG Chatbot
problem: General-purpose chatbots can answer health questions fluently but ungrounded, with no way to check where an answer came from — a real risk in a health context.
solution: A local Retrieval-Augmented Generation chatbot that answers only from ingested MedlinePlus content and cites the exact source pages under every answer, running entirely on local models so there's no paid API and no data leaving the machine.
note: Educational project, not a medical device — the app shows a standing disclaimer and reminds users to consult a healthcare professional.

title: Human Flow Analytics
problem: Understanding foot traffic from video — how many distinct people passed through a space over time — usually means watching footage manually, with no simple way to get a count per time window.
solution: A Streamlit app that runs YOLOv8 detection and tracking on an uploaded video, counts unique tracked individuals per minute, and returns an annotated video plus a downloadable chart and CSV.
features: Upload mp4/avi/mov and get back an annotated video with a numbered box on every tracked person
Per-minute unique-person counts shown as a line or bar chart
CSV export of unique counts per minute
Progress bar and total processing time shown during the run
note: "Unique" counts unique tracker IDs — if the tracker loses someone (occlusion, leaving and re-entering frame) they can be counted again. A known, documented limitation rather than a validated people-counting accuracy figure.

title: Appointment AI
problem: Small service businesses lose real time to scheduling — customers message or call to book, check, cancel, or reschedule, and staff manually check availability and update records for every request.
solution: A conversational AI agent that handles the entire appointment lifecycle through chat — checking live services and availability, then booking, checking, cancelling, and rescheduling appointments directly in Google Sheets, with automatic email confirmations.
features: Natural-language chat agent with conversation memory, not a fixed-menu bot
Checks the live service catalog and weekly availability before booking anything
Books, checks, cancels, and reschedules appointments as agent tool calls against Google Sheets
Tracks customers and their appointment history automatically
Sends email confirmations via Gmail

title: AI Voice Agent — Vapi Tools
problem: Phone-based bookings need a human available to answer every call, check slot availability, and log the result — expensive to staff and inconsistent to track.
solution: A webhook backend that plugs into Vapi's voice AI as callable tools, checking slot availability and booking, cancelling, or rescheduling appointments in Google Sheets in real time during a live call, then logging the outcome once the call ends.
features: Webhook endpoint that routes each Vapi tool call (check slot, book, cancel, reschedule) to the matching Google Sheets action
Real-time slot-availability check before a booking is confirmed
Looks up the existing booking first when handling a cancel or reschedule request
Structured responses returned to Vapi so the voice agent can speak the result back to the caller
A separate call-ended webhook logs every completed call for review
